question_or_target: Implement a pre-emit scanner that fails the build when the staging tree contains any of: a .git directory or gitlink, node_modules, __pycache__, *.log, transcript/session JSONL, an OS cache directory, or any single file above a configured byte ceiling. Distinct from IMP-0004: this classifies by PATH ROLE, not by content entropy.

residual_unknowns.claim: tools/plugin/payload-allowlist.json (IMP-0001) is absent on this worktree. The scanner does not expand or consult an allowlist; it deny-lists by path role. Packer integration that refuses non-allowlisted paths remains IMP-0001's job.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: After IMP-0001 authors the allowlist, wire forbidden_scan into the packer pre-emit path and re-run both probes against a staged payload built from the allowlist.
